Shipment-sequencing product gaps (backlogit code side; OPTIONAL, deferred per spike 001-SP). Make multi-shipment ordering clean for long-running dark-factory runs. Candidates: (a) shipment-scoped queue_position so ordering does not renumber across the combined default-status queue view (queue_position is a global integer across all item types today: internal/core/queue.go buildQueueOrderClause + MoveInQueue; custom_fields.queue_position is not settable via update_item). (b) First-class shipment->shipment blocking-order affordance for `queue view --type shipment --status queued` (item_deps already supports generic edges via AddDependency, but dep_type collapses to blocks on sync: internal/core/dependencies.go). (c) Meaningful shipment priority so the queue secondary sort is well-defined (queued shipments commonly carry no priority). (d) Optional NON-authoritative ship_sequence audit surface (spike Option D) recording a dark-mode activation plan; build only after a real multi-shipment run shows activation evidence is insufficient. NOTE: the pure orchestrator/policy/playbook hardening does NOT need any of these and belongs in autoharness templates; this entry is only the optional backlogit product enhancements. Ref: docs/decisions/2026-07-29-ship-sequence-manifest-spike.md, spike 001-SP, P-017.
